changed_clause_use: [F4] Massive-particle reading: a particle of rest mass $m$ and four-velocity $U=m^{-1}P$ has energy $E=\gamma mc^2$ in a frame where its speed parameter is $v$ with $\gamma=(1-v^2/c^2)^{-1/2}$; a rest rectangular parcel's parallel length contracts by the factor $1/\gamma$ while transverse lengths are unchanged. ([[lem-sr-four-momentum-in-inertial-frame]], [[lem-sr-boost-time-length-and-velocity-formulas]], [[post-sr-massive-particle-dynamics]])
rows.review_scope: Focused check of actual use of corrected clause (c), unchanged clauses (a)-(b), and proof implementation. No full unrelated mathematical re-audit.

changed_clause_use:
[F4] ([[lem-sr-four-momentum-in-inertial-frame]], Statement (a)–(c)): in an
inertial frame with $n=e_0$ the components are
$(P^0,P^1,P^2,P^3)=(E_n(P)/c,q^1,q^2,q^3)$ and the mass-shell identity holds
in components; for $P=mU$ with chart coordinate velocity $w$ one has
$E=m\gamma_wc^2$, $\mathbf p=m\gamma_w\mathbf w$; under a passive boost the
components transform as the components of $P$, the combination
$E^2-c^2|\mathbf p|^2$ is invariant and equals $m(P)^2c^4$ for future timelike
$P$ and $0$ for future null $P$.

changed_clause_use: Adopt [[post-sr-massive-particle-dynamics]] (massive-particle momentum, the identification of measured quantities and isolated collision balance) and the SI conventions of [[def-sr-si-units-and-coordinate-conventions]]. Let $(A,V,\eta,C^+)$ be the affine Minkowski model, $c>0$, let $(o;e_0,e_1,e_2,e_3)$ be an inertial frame with stationary observer $n:=e_0$, spatial Euclidean structure $(S,\delta,|\cdot|)$ and inertial chart $x$ ([[def-inertial-frame-and-inertial-chart]], [[def-spatial-euclidean-structure-of-an-inertial-frame]]), and let a massive particle have constant mass $m>0$ and four-momentum $P=mU$ with $U$ future timelike, $\eta(U,U)=-c^2$. Let $y$ be a worldline of the particle whose inertial coordinate path is $t\mapsto(ct,r(t))$ and whose coordinate velocity $w(t)=r'(t)\in S$ of [[def-sr-newtonian-comparison-quantities]]\,(b) equals a fixed $w$ at the instant considered; then in this frame $P=m\gamma_w(c,w)$ with $\gamma_w=(1-|w|^2/c^2)^{-1/2}$ ([[lem-sr-four-momentum-in-inertial-frame]]\,(b), [[thm-sr-proper-time-and-observer-decomposition]]\,(e)).

[L7] Frame components of the four-momentum: for $P=mU$ with $m>0$ constant the components in the frame are $P=m\gamma_w(c,w)$, that is $E_n(P)=m\gamma_wc^2$ and $q_n(P)=m\gamma_ww$ ([[lem-sr-four-momentum-in-inertial-frame]]\,(b)).
